subject: MSA + Order Form: inspection runway, redlines, and evidence onramp
messages:
From: Alex Greene <agreene@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Veridian Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA / Order Form — questions on security exhibit before we send redlines

Karthik —

Thanks for the draft MSA/order form. Before we formally redline, a few security-exhibit items we need clarity on so our legal/procurement team can scope the review:

1) SOC 2 scope: will the SOC 2 you reference be scoped to production and staging, or production only? We need the exact control statement so our InfoSec can map it to our vendor assessment.

2) Pen test language: your draft mentions customer inspection/pen-testing but no explicit constraints. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires staging-only tests, notice windows, and whether you will provide ephemeral staging accounts?

3) Audit frequency and evidence cadence: we need a concrete rubric — how often will you provide artifacts (full report vs. snapshots), what artifact types (system architecture, configuration snapshots, limited logs), and expected SLAs for evidence delivery? We want to avoid open-ended 'reasonable request' language.

4) Redaction/retention: what level of redaction will you accept for customer-facing log extracts and how long do you retain telemetry used for audits?

If you can send proposed redline snippets for the MSA security exhibit (audit rights + pen-test clause + evidence cadence) that would speed legal review. Also please attach your latest SOC 2 report or a secure link to it.

We can do a 30-min call if that's easier — our team is available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Regards,
Alex Greene
Director, Information Security — Veridian Health

Attachments: initial-question-set.xlsx (referenced above)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Greene <agreene@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — questions on security exhibit before we send redlines

Alex — thanks for the clear list. High-level positions and next steps below; Laura and Ben are looped for legal/security wording and scope details.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covers production controls; we provide a scoped attestation and can produce a SOC 2 bridge letter for a subset of staging controls on request for contracts that require it.
- Pen tests: Redwood prefers that penetration testing be limited to non-production (staging) and scheduled with 48-72h notice. We provide ephemeral accounts and a single point of contact during testing. For forensic or continuous testing requests we ask for mutual consent and a signed statement of scope.
- Audit/evidence cadence: propose a deterministic split: (a) annual full SOC 2 Type II report, (b) quarterly evidence snapshots (artifact bundle) containing architecture diagram, control mappings, sampling of anonymized logs (time-boxed), and a short runbook explaining evidence generation.
- Redaction/retention: we will provide redacted logs for audit purposes; retention windows are documented in Appendix A of the Order Form (standard is 90 days for raw telemetry, 12 months aggregated). We can negotiate a longer retention for enterprise commitments.

Actionable next steps:
1) I'll attach a short redline bundle (MSA exhibit snippets + Order Form appendix) for you to review — these are intended to be carveouts rather than full rewrites.
2) Laura will propose specific contract language to limit inspection to staged environments, restrict frequency, and codify evidence buckets.
3) Ben will confirm pen-test operational requirements (notice window, contact, scope matrix).
4) If acceptable, we can meet Wed 2028-09-20 at 10:00 PT for a 30-min alignment.

Please see attached: Veridian_MSA_Redlines.docx (redline snippets) and a placeholder SOC2 link; I'll follow up with the formal SOC 2 PDF via secure upload.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Greene <agreene@veridianhealth.com>

Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — questions on security exhibit before we send redlines

Karthik/Laura/Ben —

Thanks — that helps. A few clarifying points from Veridian's side after an internal huddle:

- Staging-only pen tests are acceptable, provided Redwood confirms in the contract that staging will be a functionally equivalent environment (we'll list critical modules) and that production credentials or live customer data will never be used.
- We need an explicit "no more than once per 12-months" baseline for full forensic inspections unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. That baseline is important for our change governance.
- Quarterly snapshot bundles are fine as long as they include: latest SOC 2 report (or link to it), system diagram (network/dataflow), a sampling of logs (with PII redacted) covering a sample window (we usually request a 72-hour window), and a short summary from you explaining how the sample maps to SOC 2 controls.

Can you provide: (a) the link or attachment to your latest SOC 2 report, (b) a short example snapshot bundle (even a mocked example) so our InfoSec can validate, and (c) a proposed sentence we can insert into the MSA about the pen-test frequency baseline?

We also need a DocuSign link for the Order Form once redlines are done.

Happy to take the Wed 9/20 slot if you confirm.

Best,
Alex Greene
Director, Information Security — Veridian Health

Attachment: Veridian_Security_Checklist.xlsx

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — questions on security exhibit before we send redlines

Alex —

Thanks — we appreciate the concrete asks. For speed, we've drafted suggested contract snippets below that you can test in your redline — these are intended to be prescriptive and avoid open-ended phrases. Please treat as negotiable language.

Suggested MSA exhibit snippets (security & audit rights):

1) Audit rights (evidence bundle / cadence):
"Upon Customer's written request, Redwood will provide an evidence bundle consisting of (i) Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report; (ii) an updated system architecture diagram; (iii) control mapping to SOC 2 criteria; and (iv) anonymized log extracts for a mutually agreed 72-hour sample window. Redwood will provide the annual SOC 2 report within five (5) business days of Customer's request and quarterly snapshot bundles within ten (10) business days. Requests for additional or more frequent evidence must be agreed in writing and may be subject to additional fees for collection and redaction work."

2) Penetration testing / inspection limits:
"Customer may conduct penetration testing against Redwood's non-production (staging) environment provided Customer: (a) provides at least forty-eight (48) hours' prior written notice; (b) limits activity to the mutually-agreed scope and test accounts; (c) does not use production credentials or live customer data; and (d) engages Redwood's designated contact during testing. Full forensic inspections of Redwood's production environment will be permitted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period absent mutual written consent. Redwood reserves the right to suspend testing that materially threatens service availability."

3) Redaction and retention:
"Redwood will provide anonymized and redacted artifacts for audit purposes. Raw telemetry containing customer PII will not be shared. Redwood's standard retention for raw telemetry is ninety (90) days; aggregated audit artifacts are retained for twelve (12) months. Parties may negotiate alternative retention for an enterprise addendum."

Operational notes (not contract language):
- We'll upload the SOC 2 PDF to a secure S3 link (I will share by EOD).
- Ben: please prepare a 1-page 'snapshot example' (mock bundle) we can send to Veridian for InfoSec validation (include sample diagram, redacted log snippet, and mapping table).
- Karthik: once Alex confirms the high-level positions, I'll convert the snippets above into tracked-change redlines for the MSA exhibit and the Order Form appendix.

Next steps: Karthik, will you confirm Wed 9/20 10:00 PT and I'll calendar a 30-min call with Alex + our engineering/security leads. Alex — I'll share the SOC 2 link and the mocked snapshot in a separate secure message before the call.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_report_redwood_2027.pdf (will be uploaded to secure link), MutualActionPlan.xlsx
